articles.title: Each Voivod Member Names Their Favorite Prog Album
articles.summary: Members of Canadian thrash/prog metal band Voivod have each selected their all-time favorite progressive rock and metal albums. The extensive article explores the diverse forms and subgenres within progressive music, detailing its evolution and variety. This offers a deep dive into the musical influences and preferences of a prominent group in the international progressive music scene.

articles.title: Govt sets up six sector groups to fast-track ‘Make in India 2.0’ push
articles.summary: The Indian government has established six sector-specific working groups to identify 100 key products for enhanced domestic manufacturing. This strategic initiative aims to significantly reduce the nation's import dependence, promoting self-reliance and boosting the 'Make in India' drive across various sectors. For SSB aspirants, this highlights India's commitment to strengthening its industrial base and economic sovereignty, crucial for national security and resilience.

articles.title: Sri Lanka Navy welcomes INS Airavat
articles.summary: Indian Naval Ship Airavat received a traditional welcome in Colombo, Sri Lanka, delivering critical spares for the Sri Lanka Coast Guard. This goodwill visit underscores India's commitment to bolstering maritime security cooperation and strengthening bilateral defence ties with its key island neighbour. Such interactions enhance regional stability and India's strategic influence.

articles.title: Going Bacharach focuses on the music rather than biography
articles.summary: Burt Bacharach, a legendary composer, created countless universally recognizable songs that many know without realizing it. His remarkable catalog includes classics like "Raindrops Keep Fallin' on My Head," "I'll Never Fall in Love Again," and "(They Long to Be) Close to You." Bacharach's distinctive melodic genius profoundly shaped popular music, leaving an enduring legacy cherished by generations worldwide.

articles.title: Indian Army revives desert water sources; offers lifeline to wildlife in Thar
articles.summary: A deadly car blast has occurred in Tel Aviv, with police ruling out any militant connection, though details about a woman were mentioned. Separately, former US President Donald Trump engaged in a fiery personal attack on a CNN reporter, resulting in a notable clash. These fragmented reports indicate both an international incident and a high-profile political confrontation.

articles.title: Gantois Industries inaugurates its first weaving manufacturing facility in India
articles.summary: Gantois Industries, a leading French firm specializing in high-performance woven and perforated metal solutions, officially inaugurated its new facility in Sanand, India, on June 3, 2026. This strategic move signifies the company's expansion into the Indian market, bringing its specialized manufacturing capabilities and technological expertise to the region, enhancing international industrial collaboration.
